title: This Surgeon Does THIS Before Every Surgery 🤯 #shorts
description:
Adley Kinsman shares the story of a doctor who wears his full surgical garb and headlight into the OR to pray with patients. She highlights how this unique, faith-driven approach creates an unstoppable, highly shareable word-of-mouth marketing machine. ⚡
